parties.name: TLS client
parties.description: Initiates TLS handshakes and sends client-side handshake messages.

parties.name: TLS server
parties.description: Accepts TLS connections and selects handshake parameters.

parties.name: Certificate URL host
parties.description: Serves certificate objects at client-provided URLs.

channels.name: TLS connection
channels.description: Carries TLS handshake, alert, and application records between a client and server.

channels.name: TLS resumption connection
channels.description: Carries a later TLS handshake using a ticket from an earlier connection.

channels.name: TLS over UDP
channels.description: Carries TLS application protocol negotiation over a UDP transport.

channels.name: TLS 1.2 resumption connection
channels.description: Carries a later TLS 1.2 abbreviated handshake using a prior session.

channels.name: Certificate URL retrieval
channels.description: Fetches each client certificate object from its selected URL host.
channels.transport: URI-scheme-dependent protocol (HTTP required; HTTPS or FTP optional)

endpoint_sources.parameter: host resolved from each selected URLAndHash.url

steps.name: Client sends ClientHello
steps.condition: First ClientHello of this TLS connection; an HRR retry is a later occurrence of this same send operation and forwards selected_group/cookie/version/cipher state while removing early_data. TLS 1.3 ClientHello uses legacy_version 0x0303 and exactly one zero legacy_compression_methods byte.

steps.name: Server sends ServerHello
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 ServerHello selecting the acceptable version and cryptographic parameters for either the direct or retry handshake branch. TLS 1.3 ServerHello uses legacy_version 0x0303 and legacy_compression_method 0.

steps.name: Server sends HelloRetryRequest
steps.condition: Acceptable parameters exist, but the initial ClientHello lacks the compatible key_share needed for selected (EC)DHE, or the server requests a cookie.

steps.name: Server sends EncryptedExtensions
steps.condition: TLS 1.3; carries negotiated responses not required to establish cryptographic context, including ALPN and accepted early_data when applicable.

steps.name: Server sends CertificateRequest
steps.condition: TLS 1.3: in main handshake only when certificate authentication is selected and server requests client authentication; post-handshake only after main handshake and if client offered post_handshake_auth.

steps.name: Server sends Certificate
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 certificate authentication selected (no PSK); server certificate list is non-empty.

steps.name: Server sends CertificateVerify
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 server authenticates with a certificate.

steps.name: Server sends Finished
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 main handshake Finished or TLS 1.2 full/resumed handshake Finished as sequenced on that branch.

steps.name: Client sends Certificate
steps.condition: TLS 1.3: responds to main or post-handshake CertificateRequest, echoing that same request context; may be empty if client declines/cannot provide a suitable certificate.

steps.name: Client sends CertificateVerify
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 Certificate is non-empty, in main or post-handshake authentication; signature matches that Certificate and request context. TLS 1.2 separate CertificateVerify step is used for legacy mode.

steps.name: Client sends Finished
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 main or post-handshake Finished, or TLS 1.2 full/resumed handshake Finished as sequenced on that branch.

steps.name: Client sends ApplicationData
steps.condition: TLS application data on this connection; record protection and negotiated maximum fragment rules apply.

steps.name: Server sends NewSessionTicket
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 ticket issuance; ticket_lifetime MUST be at most 604800 seconds. A zero-lifetime ticket may be sent but the client discards it.

steps.name: Client sends resumption ClientHello
steps.condition: Initial or retry ClientHello on the ticketed TLS resumption connection. A retry keeps permitted fields, replaces key_share for selected_group, copies cookie, removes early_data and recomputes PSK ticket age/binder.

steps.name: Server sends resumption ServerHello
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 ServerHello on resumed transport, either selecting an accepted offered PSK or selecting non-PSK parameters for the full-handshake fallback. TLS 1.3 ServerHello uses legacy_version 0x0303 and legacy_compression_method 0.

steps.name: Server sends resumption EncryptedExtensions
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 EncryptedExtensions after resumption ServerHello; negotiates current-handshake extensions, and includes early_data only if accepted.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 ServerHello
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 negotiated. If accepting prior session resumption, omit RFC 6066 extensions; if resumption is denied (including a different server_name), continue full handshake and negotiate extensions normally. On a full handshake, each response is present only when requested and accepted.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 Certificate
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 full handshake uses certificate authentication.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 ServerKeyExchange
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 selected key exchange suite requires ServerKeyExchange.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 CertificateRequest
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 server requests client authentication.

steps.name: Server sends CertificateStatus
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 only: status_request received and acknowledged; server elects to send one OCSP response.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 Certificate
steps.condition: TLS 1.2: CertificateRequest received; client chooses certificate form.

steps.name: Client sends CertificateURL
steps.condition: TLS 1.2: CertificateRequest received and client_certificate_url negotiated in both hellos; client chooses URL form instead of Certificate. Each URLAndHash.padding byte is 0x01.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 CertificateVerify
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 client sent a certificate requiring proof of private-key possession.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 ChangeCipherSpec
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 full handshake; switch client write state before client Finished.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 ChangeCipherSpec
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 full handshake; server switches write state before server Finished.

steps.name: Client sends KeyUpdate
steps.condition: After client sent Finished; request_update selects whether peer response is required; sender encrypts with old keys then advances its sending keys.

steps.name: Server sends KeyUpdate
steps.condition: After server sent Finished; request_update selects whether peer response is required; sender encrypts with old keys then advances its sending keys.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.3 compatibility CCS
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 compatibility mode: unprotected single-byte 0x01 immediately after initial ClientHello when early_data offered, or before the client second flight if not offering early data.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.3 compatibility CCS
steps.condition: TLS 1.3 compatibility mode: send unprotected single-byte 0x01 immediately after first ServerHello or HelloRetryRequest; if client supplied non-empty legacy_session_id, server MUST send it.

steps.name: Client sends Alert
steps.condition: Shared Alert wire form includes close_notify, user_canceled, and protocol errors. Client sends fatal unexpected_message after an unrequested post-handshake CertificateRequest.

steps.name: Server sends Alert
steps.condition: Shared Alert wire form includes close_notify, user_canceled, no_application_protocol, unrecognized_name, and protocol errors.

steps.name: Client closes TLS write side
steps.condition: After client close_notify, or after fatal error alert.

steps.name: Client sends UDP ALPN ClientHello
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 ALPN over UDP transport; offer ordered ProtocolNameList.

steps.name: Server sends UDP ALPN ServerHello
steps.condition: Select exactly one client-advertised protocol; selection is definitive for connection until renegotiated.

steps.name: Server sends UDP ALPN no-overlap Alert
steps.condition: Fatal no_application_protocol if no protocol overlap.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption ClientHello
steps.condition: Client requests prior session resumption and sends extensions as for a full handshake.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption ServerHello
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 ServerHello on the resumption transport; accepted abbreviate or denied-resumption full-handshake branch is selected by dependency conditions.

steps.name: Server closes TLS write side
steps.condition: After server close_notify, or after a fatal error alert.

steps.name: Server sends resumption fallback Certificate
steps.condition: Server did not select any acceptable PSK and can complete a non-PSK full handshake using certificate authentication.

steps.name: Server sends resumption fallback CertificateVerify
steps.condition: Fallback non-PSK handshake authenticates server with a certificate.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback Certificate
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 server denies resumption because resumption ClientHello server_name differs; full handshake proceeds.

steps.name: Client sends resumption EndOfEarlyData
steps.condition: Only when server accepted early_data in resumption EncryptedExtensions; after server Finished.

steps.name: TLS server connects to certificate URL host
steps.condition: One URL at a time from the received CertificateURL list; scheme is enabled by server policy.

steps.name: TLS server fetches certificate URL
steps.condition: Fetch each selected URL directly using its URI-scheme protocol; server must support HTTP and may support enabled HTTPS or FTP; do not follow HTTP redirects.

steps.name: Client sends Alert on resumed TLS connection
steps.condition: close_notify before client closes its write side unless client already sent an error alert; fatal alerts stop further exchange.

steps.name: Server sends Alert on resumed TLS connection
steps.condition: Shared TLS 1.3 Alert wire form for this resumed channel, including fatal no_application_protocol when no current ALPN overlap, close_notify, and protocol errors.

steps.name: Client closes resumed TLS write side
steps.condition: After client close_notify or fatal error alert.

steps.name: Server closes resumed TLS write side
steps.condition: After server close_notify or fatal error alert.

steps.name: Client sends Alert on TLS 1.2 resumed connection
steps.condition: close_notify before client closes its write side unless client already sent an error alert; fatal alerts stop further exchange.

steps.name: Server sends Alert on TLS 1.2 resumed connection
steps.condition: Shared TLS 1.2 Alert wire form on abbreviated or full-fallback resumption channel, including fatal no_application_protocol, close_notify and protocol errors.

steps.name: Client closes TLS 1.2 resumed write side
steps.condition: After client close_notify or fatal error alert.

steps.name: Server closes TLS 1.2 resumed write side
steps.condition: After server close_notify or fatal error alert.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback ServerKeyExchange
steps.condition: Only when selected TLS 1.2 cipher suite requires ServerKeyExchange.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback CertificateRequest
steps.condition: Only when server requests client authentication.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback ServerHelloDone
steps.condition: After optional ServerKeyExchange and CertificateRequest.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback ClientKeyExchange
Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback CertificateVerify
steps.condition: Only when client sent a certificate requiring proof of private-key possession.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback CCS
Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback Finished
Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback CCS
Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback Finished
Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback Certificate
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 full fallback only when server requested client authentication; choose Certificate form.

steps.name: Client sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback CertificateURL
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 full fallback: client_certificate_url negotiated in both hellos and client chooses URL form in place of Certificate. Each URLAndHash.padding byte is 0x01.

steps.name: Server sends TLS 1.2 resumption fallback CertificateStatus
steps.condition: TLS 1.2 full fallback: status_request received and acknowledged; server elects to send OCSP response immediately after server Certificate.

steps.name: Server sends resumption HelloRetryRequest
steps.condition: PSK-DHE mode selected, but initial resumption ClientHello lacks a compatible key_share; HRR requests the supported group and may include a cookie.

ticket -> offered identity; obfuscated_ticket_age = client ticket age + ticket_age_add modulo 2^32; PSK derives from resumption_master_secret and that ticket nonce.

Handshake complete.

max_fragment_length request is one of 2^9, 2^10, 2^11, 2^12; server accepts only by returning the same requested value.

status_request received; server elects to return a certificate-status response and acknowledges status_request with empty extension.
Full TLS 1.2 handshake uses certificate authentication.
Selected cipher suite requires ServerKeyExchange.

TLS 1.2 status_request acknowledged and server elects to send status; immediately after Certificate.
If ServerKeyExchange is required.
If server requests client authentication and no ServerKeyExchange intervenes.

client_certificate_url was requested and accepted; client chooses URL form instead of Certificate.
If CertificateRequest was received, client certificate message precedes ClientKeyExchange.

When CertificateVerify was sent.

step_dependencies.condition: TLS 1.3 ALPN was offered; server selects exactly one protocol in the client list, normally its most-preferred supported match.

field_relations.derive: selected protocol is one member of the offered list

step_dependencies.condition: No protocol overlap in ALPN list; server cannot select a protocol.
If server uses requested server_name for certificate/policy selection, echo empty server_name; on accepted resumption omit server_name response.

Resumption requires current SNI valid for original certificate; server may require it to equal original SNI. Ticket age = obfuscated_ticket_age - ticket_age_add modulo 2^32 and is within server tolerance.
Selected PSK binder validates against the offered identity; selected identity refers to the same offered ticket; cipher suite uses same KDF hash as ticket-issuing connection.
If selected psk_ke, server omits key_share; if selected psk_dhe_ke, both peers provide key_share for negotiated group.
0-RTT only when ticket carries early_data allowance; PSK identity used for encryption is first identity in ClientHello.
Accept early_data only if first PSK identity selected, TLS version/cipher/ALPN equal PSK-associated values, ticket age is fresh, binder validates, and replay policy permits it.
On stale age, duplicate/replayed ClientHello, unavailable replay state, mismatch, or server refusal, omit acceptance and continue 1-RTT where possible; stale age alone does not require abort.
Main handshake complete; client offered post_handshake_auth.

Client did not offer post_handshake_auth; client sends fatal unexpected_message.

Server request_update is update_requested; client responds with update_not_requested before its next ApplicationData.

TLS 1.3 compatibility mode with non-empty legacy_session_id_echo context; dummy CCS only before client Finished.
Prior alert was user_canceled; next client alert is close_notify.
Prior alert was user_canceled; next server alert is close_notify.
Alert description is close_notify, or fatal error alert already terminated connection.
Alert description is close_notify, or fatal error alert already terminated connection.

TLS 1.2 OCSP response unacceptable: fatal bad_certificate_status_response.
Unknown SNI: server may send fatal unrecognized_name or continue handshake; no warning-level alert recommended.
TLS 1.2 client receives max_fragment_length response different from request, or invalid requested value: illegal_parameter; client aborts.
TLS 1.2 server receives invalid max_fragment_length request: illegal_parameter; server aborts.
status_request received AND server echoed it AND server elects to send; response follows Certificate.
Select exactly one protocol from client list; server preference chooses the highest supported match.

step_dependencies.condition: No client-advertised protocol supported.
